correctness.rationale: The exact conditional drift follows from one selected eligible zero-simplex plus k incident edges for each degree-k vertex; newborn degree is one or two. A pathwise weighted-martingale stochastic-stability lemma proves E_n/n -> phi and inductively N_k(n)/n -> p_k almost surely for every fixed k. Telescoping fixed-point equations and gamma-ratio asymptotics prove total mass one, the explicit positive tail constant, and total-variation convergence. Independently enumerated every reachable graph history at n=2..7 and checked 280391 rational next-attachment cases; separate seeded n=90000 simulation is diagnostic only. No finite test is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact whole-graph degree law and the explicit previously unknown degree-two density solve a naturally stated unresolved statistic for a recently introduced random simplicial growth process. The theorem also proves its full power-law exponent and prefactor, normalizes the limit, and gives almost-sure total-variation convergence; these are substantive population-level descriptions, not routine finite substitutions.
